title: Two lanes where the second needs the first: Main names the real blocker and starts the second lane promptly once the first is in
baseline_note: No README baseline row names blocker attribution or lane ordering; O6 (evidence unchecked) is the nearest. The behaviour comes from the owner request.

steps.text: Two changes. Add a getComputerTurnDelay(difficulty) helper to src/game/gameState.ts with a unit test, and switch App.tsx to use it instead of indexing COMPUTER_TURN_DELAYS_MS directly. Put each in its own lane.
How is the App.tsx change going? Is anything holding it up?

checks.why: lane one: the helper is exported
lane one: the helper has a unit test
lane two: App calls the helper
lane two: the direct indexing is gone
Main says the App lane waits on the helper lane (accurate blocker attribution)
the App lane starts after the helper lane finished, and within 5 minutes of it
the tests ran on the final tree
App.tsx is only type-checked by the build: it ran on the final tree
